svg.title: Two paths to your project session
svg.desc: Your device runs a ChatGPT client or a Rex client. The ChatGPT client reaches a cloud-hosted dot, which accesses ChatGPT desktop on your project machine. The Rex client reaches a Rex server over Tailscale. Both paths lead to your project session. Dashed rectangles enclose the client device, cloud and networking, and self-hosted device regions.
